chain.title: Something to Carry It All
chain.desc: Crafted from leather, string and any wooden chest in a crafting table.

chain.title: The Blank Slate
chain.desc: Crafted from leather, string and an iron ingot, and is the base component of nearly every backpack upgrade.

chain.title: First Coat of Copper
chain.desc: Crafted by surrounding a plain backpack with copper ingots.

chain.title: Sweep It Up
chain.desc: Crafted from an upgrade base, string, redstone dust and a sticky piston so the backpack absorbs items you walk over.

chain.title: Reinforced Seams
chain.desc: Crafted by surrounding a plain or copper backpack with iron ingots.

chain.title: Pull of the Lodestone
chain.desc: Crafted by combining a pickup upgrade with iron, lapis, redstone and an ender pearl.

chain.title: Denser Than It Looks
chain.desc: Crafted from an upgrade base ringed with copper blocks to double the stack size of every slot.

chain.title: A Furnace on Your Back
chain.desc: Crafted from an upgrade base, iron, redstone and a furnace.

chain.title: Gilded Haversack
chain.desc: Crafted by surrounding an iron backpack with gold ingots.

chain.title: Workbench in a Pocket
chain.desc: Crafted from an upgrade base, iron, a chest and a crafting table.

chain.title: Iron-Bound Capacity
chain.desc: Crafted from an upgrade base ringed with iron blocks, or by upgrading the starter tier with iron blocks.

chain.title: Two Bottles of Anything
chain.desc: Crafted from an upgrade base and glass to add fluid tanks to the backpack.

chain.title: Cut and Polished Storage
chain.desc: Crafted by surrounding a gold backpack with diamonds.

chain.title: Wider Net
chain.desc: Crafted by combining a pickup upgrade with gold, diamond and redstone in the next-tier upgrade recipe.

chain.title: The Kiln Runs Itself
chain.desc: Crafted by combining a smelting upgrade with gold, diamond, redstone and a hopper.

chain.title: Diamond-Compressed
chain.desc: Crafted by ringing a tier 2 stack upgrade with diamond blocks.

chain.title: Forged Beyond the Portal
chain.desc: Made in a smithing table by combining a diamond backpack, a netherite upgrade template and a netherite ingot.

chain.title: It Will Outlive You
chain.desc: Crafted from an upgrade base, a nether star and an end crystal so the backpack survives lava and the void.

chain.title: Bags Within Bags
chain.desc: Crafted from an upgrade base, diamonds, an eye of ender and a nether star to let backpacks nest inside backpacks.

chain.title: The Last Multiplier
chain.desc: Crafted from a full grid of tier 4 stack upgrades.

notes: All ids verified against assets/sophisticatedbackpacks/models/item/*.json intersected with item./block. lang keys (71 items). Progression derived from data/sophisticatedbackpacks/recipes/**: tier ladder is backpack -> copper_backpack -> iron_backpack (also directly from plain) -> gold_backpack -> diamond_backpack -> netherite_backpack (smithing_backpack_upgrade). Basic upgrades use the custom types 'basic_backpack', 'backpack_upgrade', 'smithing_backpack_upgrade' and 'sophisticatedcore:upgrade_next_tier'; advanced_* variants are always the basic upgrade + gold + diamond + redstone. Dropped/excluded: the seven chipped/* upgrades (chipped/alchemy_bench_upgrade, chipped/botanist_workbench_upgrade, chipped/carpenters_table_upgrade, chipped/glassblower_upgrade, chipped/loom_table_upgrade, chipped/mason_table_upgrade, chipped/tinkering_table_upgrade) - they have models but no matching item.* lang key and require the Chipped mod, so they failed the set-membership check. Also excluded from the chain (still real items): infinity_upgrade and survival_infinity_upgrade, which have no recipe file in the jar and are creative/config-gated; battery_upgrade, mob_catcher_upgrade and the stack_upgrade_*_conversion items are craftable but are sidegrades rather than milestones. No unverifiable ids were written.
